Question
========
What is the main focus of quality assurance (QA)?

Answerlist
----------
* correcting errors after data collection
* preventive measures during data handling
* timely adding metadata
* preparing data for long-term archiving


Solution
========
The main focus of quality assurance is preventive measures during data handling.
